scenes.hook: H T M L Checkboxes & Radio Buttons. Let’s make it simple.
scenes.idea: Checkboxes allow independent choices; radio buttons select within a group. Start by understanding the role it plays in a page.
scenes.code: Use the same name for radio buttons that belong to one group.
scenes.result: Here’s an illustration of the result. Compare it with the example you just saw.
scenes.tip: Checkboxes are useful when several options may be selected together. Keep this detail in mind when writing your own example.
scenes.caution: Associate every control with a label, including checkboxes and radios.
scenes.try: Create two skill checkboxes and a radio group for experience level. Change one part, then compare your result.
scenes.close: Like, share, and subscribe for more web development basics.
